Interface JobInfoList

All Known Implementing Classes:
LinkedJobInfoList, PSJobInfoList
public interface JobInfoList

Name: JobInfoList

Description: A JobInfoList is a list used to update raw sampled performance counters of a node or section.

Date: 18/giu/2009 Time: 17:00:44

Version:
1.0 Modified by Ashanka (May 2010): Patch: Multi-Sink Perf. Index Description: Added new Performance index for capturing 1. global response time (ResponseTime per Sink) 2. global throughput (Throughput per Sink) each sink per class.
Author:
Bertoli Marco
